title: Blood Type Rarity Isn't Universal: AB Negative Is 1% In The US
hook: AB negative is 1% in the US; blood-type frequency depends on the population.
closing: A rare label needs a population attached; diverse donors help make blood supplies reflect the people needing them.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: AB negative represents 1% in this US distribution. It is the rarest listed type, not necessarily the rarest blood classification worldwide.
Rh-negative blood accounts for 15% in this comparison. That subgroup is much smaller than the Rh-positive population.
O-positive blood reaches 53% among Latin American donors in these data. Frequencies differ across the donor groups compared.
